text: Vega comes back to the pole, but not to the same place: 3.4° last time, 5.7° next. The star hardly changed. What changed is the tilt of the thing pointing at it. I keep wanting that to mean something and I have not decided what yet.

ATLAS looked for a thing, found nothing, and published the nothing with a number on it: if it happens, it happens less than one time in ten. A search that comes back empty still draws a line. I like that a no can be measured.
